Professional LED lighting stock – new goods

Complete warehouse stock of a professional lighting wholesaler: LED floodlights and high-bay luminaires (Tec-Mar, Duralamp, VARION), moisture-proof, office and indoor luminaires, LED strips and aluminium profiles (Duralamp, BILTON, Nordic Aluminium), LED drivers (Mean Well, Tridonic, TCI), lamps (Osram, Philips, LEDVANCE, Duralamp) and Casambi / DALI lighting controls. 26,754 new pieces in 1,842 lines, mostly in original single packaging, stored on labelled shelves (about 30–40 euro pallets).
